newsitem.title: LATVIA: LATVIAN BUDGET SURPLUS AT 21.71MLN LATS BY JUNE26.
newsitem.headline: LATVIAN BUDGET SURPLUS AT 21.71MLN LATS BY JUNE26.

text.p: Latvia was running a state budget surplus of 21.71 million lats as of June 26, the finance ministry said on Friday.
Spending reached 271.043 million lats by June 26 while revenues reached 249.335 million lats, the ministry said in a statement.
The ministry said that the state's internal debt came to 416.242 million lats, financed by state T-bills worth 133.038 million lats.
The debt was also made up by credits from the International Monetary Fund (IMF) and the World Bank, worth 64.785 million lats and 62.508 million lats respectively.
